title: Refresh prices button, prices-changed marker and Reset Prices (G-07-2)
reference_behaviour: A round Refresh prices button re-runs the numbers with the latest data without changing entry prices; a small marker on a leg price says the live price moved; Reset Prices re-bases every leg to the current price and clears the markers.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-135 AC-3 says there is no manual refresh button (prices are pushed). Marker and Reset Prices are REQ-077 AC-5, AC-6 (row 21), not built.
